transcript.text: new washer jumpin all over the kitchen on spin like its gonna take off?? only had it 2 days

Please switch the machine off and unplug it first. The unit is heavy and may hold water, so ease it forward carefully, ideally with help. New machines often have transit bolts in the back panel to lock the drum for shipping; if these remain fitted, the drum cannot move freely, causing violent shaking. You can see an illustration of this area in the app below. Are any transit bolts still fitted (and have you taken them out), or were they already removed?
[Helpful to see: image "Check the transit bolts have been removed" — Transit bolts hold the drum still for delivery and must be removed before use — a machine that bangs, walks or vibrates (especially when new or recently moved) often still has them fitted. They unscrew from the back of the machine. Typical layout — your machine may differ.]
idk what transit bolts are tbh?? do u mean the big bolts at the back? i can unplug it n have a look, i cant lift or tilt it tho

Please pause or cancel the programme and wait for the door to unlock on its own before opening it. A single heavy item, such as a bath mat, rug, duvet or pair of jeans, or a very small load can throw the drum off balance. Was it one heavy item or a small load (and have you evened it out), or a normal mixed load?
its happened every spin since i got it, even with a half load of towels so not just one heavy thing. no leaks tho. should i still go look at the back?

I understand the shaking persists despite previous adjustments. Please ensure the machine is stable by checking if it stands level and firm; press on each top corner to confirm there is no rocking, and verify all four feet touch a solid floor with their lock nuts tight. Switch the machine off and unplug it first. The machine is heavy and may still hold water, so ease it forward carefully, ideally with help. Did it rock or was a foot loose (and have you adjusted it), or was it already level and firm?
i think its level, it doesnt rock when i push it. can i go look at the back now tho? i unplugged it

Thanks for confirming it’s level and firm. Please remove all laundry and run a spin-only programme with the drum empty. If it starts banging or shaking violently, stop the programme straight away. Stand clear while it spins and don’t try to hold it still. Does it still shake or bang violently with the drum empty, or is it smooth?
i havent tried it empty, it does it with towels in tho. can i just go look at the back first? its unplugged already n theres no water leaking

[Heading: Cause not confirmed]
Thanks for letting me know about the ongoing shaking with specific loads. Based on what we have so far, I cannot safely pinpoint the cause. An appliance engineer is the best next step to confirm this properly; please note I am not recommending any part from here. If you haven’t had a chance yet, the check I described earlier comes first. For safety, switch the machine off and unplug it first. The machine is heavy and may still hold water, so ease it forward carefully, ideally with help.
